signals.text: Supabase Realtime events must be forwarded to every connected NiceGUI client without polling.
Synchronize multi-user card operations across all active web clients in real time.
signals.possible_indication: Ensures all participants see the same card layout and status simultaneously.

signals.text: Broadcast database mutations instantly to all listening clients via supabase-py Realtime events.

DISCOVER.core_issue: Lack of real-time synchronization prevents collaborative card management in the 'Is/Is Not' canvas.
DISCOVER.impact_value: Enables multi-user collaboration and maintains the <2000ms latency requirement for session updates.
DISCOVER.discovery_method: Architectural requirement analysis based on deferred SPEC-0001 risks and project objectives.
DISCOVER.pattern_dependencies: Implementing Supabase Realtime is the prerequisite for all card-based operations (insert, update, delete, relocate).
